סיכה וינטאג' גדולה  חתומה  Gorgeous figural Brooch "Kenneth Jay Lane" - KJL Green Jade Butterfly Brooch-- Crystals and enamel --Book piece -art.161/7 - מידות 8X4.5 ס''מ 

For over half a century and counting, the Kenneth Jay Lane jewelry line has been at the forefront of the very trends that Kenneth Jay Lane himself pioneered. A true innovator of the “Fabulous Fakes” that to this day, still convince women around the world to leave their real jewels at home…

Not only do you see the likes of contemporary icons such as Rhianna, Lady Gaga, Miley Cyrus, and Katy Perry (just to name a few) dazzling in Kenneth’s designs, but modern history’s most notable fashionistas have gravitated towards Kenneth Jay Lane since the label’s inception in 1962. Pop culture icons like Jackie Onassis Kennedy, Elizabeth Taylor, Audrey Hepburn, and even Princesses Diana and Maragret chose to wear “Kennys”, making the brand internationally sought after - and for good reason.

סיכה וינטאג' גדולה חתומה Loola Paris vintage costume jewelry

מותג תכשיטי האופנה העילית (Costume Jewelry) Loola Paris הוקם ונוהל על ידי המעצבת הפריזאית אוולין סיטבון (Evelyne Sitbon) ופעל בין השנים 1989 ל-2008. הסיכות והתכשיטים של המותג יוצרו בעבודת יד בפריז ברוח ההוט קוטור (Haute Couture)-קוטר 8 ס''מ

סיכה וינטאג' גדולה חתומה Bijoux Cascio is a highly collectible vintage Italian costume jewelry brand founded in Florence, Italy, in 1948 by Gaetano Cascio [Nasvete.com]. Known for high-fashion flair and impeccable craftsmanship, the house gained fame by collaborating with legendary Italian haute couture designers like Emilio Pucci and Carosa in the 1950s and 1960s.
A vintage Bijoux Cascio brooch is recognizable by its heavy gold-plating, Florentine
textured finishes, and dramatic, sculptural designs
